XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia Platform — feature flags + audit + customer brand + ADR-017 user-type/profile tables

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_feature_flags
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase A0 (2026-05-14) — Feature flag overrides set via the Switchboard UI. A row exists only when an admin has overridden the registered default. Missing rows mean the flag falls through to its registered default in db/feature_flags.php.
Session 2 / ADR-002 (2026-05-20) — added customer_id for multi-customer SaaS. Resolution precedence (most specific wins): (key, customer, tenant) > (key, customer, 0) > (key, 0, tenant) > (key, 0, 0) > registered default. Legacy rows pre-Session-2 have customer_id=0 and resolve identically to before.

FIELD.NAME: flag_key
FIELD.COMMENT: Three-level dotted key, e.g. ai.assistant.enabled

FIELD.NAME: customer_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-002 (Session 2). 0 = applies to all customers; >0 = scoped to that customer. Phase 0/1: only 0 and 1 (Airpay) are valid.

FIELD.NAME: tenant_id
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = applies to all tenants (within the customer scope); >0 = per-tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA)

FIELD.NAME: is_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 0|1 — the override value

FIELD.NAME: modified_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who last toggled this row

KEY.NAME: uk_key_cust_tenant
KEY.COMMENT: One override per (flag, customer, tenant) triple. Toggling reuses the same row.

INDEX.NAME: idx_cust_tenant_key
INDEX.COMMENT: Lookup path for is_enabled_for() — customer + tenant first, then key

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_feature_flag_audit
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase A0 (2026-05-14) — Every toggle on the Switchboard creates a row here. Retains the full history for SOC2 / GDPR audit evidence (target retention: 7 years). The Switchboard 'Flag history' page surfaces this as a timeline.
Session 2 / ADR-002 (2026-05-20) — added customer_id so multi-customer audit feeds can filter by customer.

FIELD.NAME: customer_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-002 (Session 2). 0 = all customers; >0 = scoped to that customer.

FIELD.NAME: old_value
FIELD.COMMENT: 0|1 before the change; NULL means 'was using registered default (no override row)'

FIELD.NAME: new_value
FIELD.COMMENT: 0|1 after the change; NULL means 'reverted to registered default (override row deleted)'

FIELD.NAME: changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who toggled — never NULL (the Switchboard requires auth)

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional admin-entered note explaining why this change was made

INDEX.NAME: idx_key_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Timeline lookup for a specific flag's history

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_customer_brand
TABLE.COMMENT:
Per-customer branding bundle (ADR-008, 2026-05-21). One row per customer id. Read on every page (manifest, theme renderer, login splash, audience navbar) so it is cached via local_sentientia_platform/customer_brand application cache.
Phase 2: replaces the hard-wired switch in \local_sentientia_platform\customer::branding() with a SELECT from this table. The return shape is identical so all callsites are unchanged.
Adding a new customer = 1 row insert + 2 icon files. No code deploy.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique customer identifier. Phase 0/1: only 1 (Airpay) exists. Phase 2+: 2..N for new customers.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Full display name (Web App Manifest `name` field)

FIELD.NAME: short_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Short name (max 12 chars recommended, Manifest `short_name`)

FIELD.NAME: theme_color
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex color like #0066A7 — Manifest theme_color + browser-chrome tint

FIELD.NAME: bg_color
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex color — PWA background_color while shell warms up

FIELD.NAME: icon_192_url
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute or relative URL to 192x192 PNG (Android home-screen)

FIELD.NAME: icon_512_url
FIELD.COMMENT: Absolute or relative URL to 512x512 PNG (splash + adaptive)

FIELD.NAME: start_url
FIELD.COMMENT: Path relative to wwwroot (e.g. /my/dashboard.php?utm=pwa)

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: BCP-47 language code (en, hi, en-IN, etc)

FIELD.NAME: status_bar_style
FIELD.COMMENT: iOS apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style — default|black|black-translucent

FIELD.NAME: categories
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated W3C PWA categories (education,productivity,...)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_user_type
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-017 — polymorphic user-type classification, 1:1 with mdl_user. Written once at provisioning (immutable per Q1 ruling 2026-05-28); user_type_factory reads it on every type-aware surface. Fresh-install parity added 2026-06-11 (D-prod): previously created only by the 2026052801 upgrade step, so clean installs (sandbox, customer-N, PHPUnit) lacked it and the factory threw. Definitions mirror db/upgrade.php exactly; the upgrade step's table_exists guards make the two paths converge.

FIELD.NAME: user_type
FIELD.COMMENT: employee | consumer | partner_employee | operator

FIELD.NAME: provisioning_source
FIELD.COMMENT: signup_public | hrms_sync | manual_admin | invite_paid | backfill_cli

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_employee_profile
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-017 — employee-only profile shape (Airpay-customer staff). Fresh-install parity 2026-06-11; mirrors db/upgrade.php 2026052801.

FIELD.NAME: manager_userid

FIELD.NAME: cost_center_path
FIELD.COMMENT: cached snapshot of mdl_user.open_path at provisioning

FIELD.NAME: consent_leaderboard
FIELD.COMMENT: opt-in to leaderboard visibility; defaults OFF (DPDP)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_partner_employee_profile

FIELD.NAME: customer_id
FIELD.COMMENT: partner-org id in the customer registry
